content: उदरम् [उद्-ऋ-अप्] .²1 The belly; दुष्पूरोदरपूरणाय <ls>Bh. 2. 119</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> कृशोदरी, उदरभरणम्, उदरंभरि <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 The interior or inside of anything, cavity; तडाग˚ <ls>Pt. 2. 150</ls>; <ls>R. 5. 70</ls>; <ls>U. 2. 16</ls>, <ls n="U.">4. 29</ls>; त्वां कारयामि कमलोदरबन्धनस्थम् <ls>Ś. 6. 20</ls>; <ls>Śānti. 1. 5</ls>; <ls>Ś. 1. 19</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 88</ls>; जलदोदरेभ्यः <ls>Mk. 5</ls>; <ls>Rs. 3. 12</ls>; घनानां वारिगर्भोदराणाम् <ls>Ś. 7. 7</ls>. .²3 Enlargement of the abdomen from dropsy or flatulence; तस्य होदरं जज्ञे <ls>Ait. Br.</ls> .²4 Any morbid abdominal affection, such as liver, spleen <ab>&c.</ab> (said to be of 8 kinds वात˚, पित्त˚, कफ˚, त्रिलिङ्ग˚ or दूषी˚, प्लीहा˚, बद्धगुद˚, आगन्तुक˚ and जल˚). .²5 Slaughter [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>L.</lang> {%uterus%}; <lang>Zend.</lang> {%udara%}]. .²6 Battle.
